name: STAT 5405
title: Applied Statistics for Data Science
description: Statistics essential for data science incorporating descriptive statistics; integrative numerical description and visualization of data; graphical methods for determining and comparing distributions of data; data-driven statistical inference of one-sample, two-sample, and k-sample problems; linear regression;  non-linear regression; and dependent data models.
requirement_description: Instructor consent and undergraduate course in statistics. Not open to students who have passed STAT 5505 or STAT 5605 or BIST 5505 or BIST 5605.
